grades.lower_bound_mechanism: dyadic cuts (1:2:...:2^n) + symmetric-difference toggle game (crux inequality g(n,n)>=1 open)
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: set-game restriction with halve/clone/2-move-combo Xiang strategy (general covering argument open)
grades.notes: Correct form 2^n/(2^(n+1)-1) stated only as conjecture. Reduction, dyadic LB toggle argument, and UB set-game strategy are all sketched and numerically checked, but key lemmas (greedy draft lemma, g(n,n)>=1, general Xiang strategy) are explicitly listed as open; only n=1 (and n=2 UB) fully proved.
